title: Re-roll: Choose the visual world
question: The second roll assigned the Transit Network Diagram. Keep it, take a winning challenger, or re-roll again.

options.label: Transit Network Diagram
options.thesis: Mobile architecture mapped as a complex but perfectly routed transit network.
options.viewport: A sprawling transit map where the user 'travels' between apps, stack elements, and experience.
options.risk: Can become visually tangled if the routes aren't kept strictly orthogonal.

raised.raise: Massive flat vector confidence spanning the entire viewport.
Methodical cataloging and strict structural framing for every text node.

options.label: Aerospace Mission Control
options.thesis: A crash-free mobile portfolio visualized as a mission-critical telemetry dashboard.
options.viewport: A dense terminal dashboard tracking live app stability and project metrics.
options.risk: Requires flawless typography so dense data doesn't feel cluttered.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Project stats and experience cascading into view on physical mechanical flaps.
options.viewport: A massive terminal board where project metrics flip into place character by character.
options.case: Fuses perfectly: mobile performance metrics map exactly to the ticking updates of a transit board.
options.risk: Requires a highly optimized animation loop to avoid layout thrashing.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.thesis: High-precision engineering shown as meticulously documented analog exposure logs.
options.viewport: Overlapping translucent sheets where tech stack layers are documented like exposure zones.
options.case: Very strong analog metaphor for deep, technical execution.
options.risk: Might feel too abstract for recruiters glancing quickly.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A standard dark mode developer portfolio.
canonCard.viewport: A standard hero section with a bento box layout below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from thousands of other developer portfolios.
